VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

The epitome of chocolate heaven🍫🤩🍰 if you love chocolate, you need this crockpot chocolate lava cake in your life!🙌 Crockpot Chocolate Lava Cake Recipe: Ingredients:  Cake Batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour ¾ cup granulated sugar 3 tbsps cocoa powder 2 tsps baking powder  ¼ tsp salt ½ cup milk ⅓ cup butter ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 tsps vanilla bean paste Cake Topping: ¾ cup granulated sugar ¾ cup light brown sugar ⅓ cup cocoa powder ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 ¼ cup hot water Instructions: 1. Mix cake batter dry ingredients: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, granulated sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.  2. Mix cake batter wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, microwave your butter and dark chocolate chips in 30 second increments until fully melted.  3. Combine your wet & dry ingredients, & spread it on the bottom of your crockpot. 4. Cake Topping: Mix your granulated sugar, brown sugar, & cocoa powder together. Sprinkle this on top of your cake batter along with the chocolate chips. Pour your hot water overtop of everything, & don’t stir it in. 5. Cover, & cook on high for 2-2.5 hours. Enjoy with vanilla ice cream & a dusting of flaky sea salt! #chocolate #dessert #chocolatelover #dessert #Recipe @Crock-Pot @Breyers Ice Cream @Gold Medal Flour @dixiecrystals @King Arthur Baking @McCormick Spices @ghiradelli

Recipe Name: Hot Fudge Chocolate Lava Cake Sundae Ingredients 1. 1 box chocolate cake mix 2. Ingredients required for cake mix (eggs, oil, water) 3. 1/2 cup chocolate chips 4. 1/4 cup cocoa powder 5. 1/2 cup hot fudge sauce 6. 1/4 cup caramel sauce 7. 4 scoops vanilla ice cream 8. 2 tbsp powdered sugar 9. 1 tsp vanilla extract 10. Chocolate syrup for drizzling Recipe 1. Preheat the oven according to the cake mix package directions. 2. Prepare the cake batter following package instructions. 3. Stir in chocolate chips and cocoa powder. 4. Pour the batter into a greased baking dish or oven-safe skillet. 5. Bake until the cake is set but still moist in the center. 6. Allow the cake to cool for 10 minutes. 7. Cut a large portion of warm cake and place it into a serving bowl. 8. Drizzle generously with hot fudge sauce. 9. Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. 10. Drizzle caramel sauce over the ice cream. 11. Add additional chocolate syrup for extra richness. 12. Let the warm cake slightly melt the ice cream. 13. Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
